news.title: Neostellar’s Willy Lee on AI Landscape Ahead of Anthropic Pre-IPO Investor Day

(Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Applied Materials Will Double Sales, Not Headcount, Thanks to AI

news.title: Meta Releases New AI Model Called Muse Wonder

This model is said to be competitive with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude.  Meta stock rose on the news. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Robinhood CIO on Investment Ideas Ahead of Earnings
news.summary: Stephanie Guild, CIO at Robinhood Markets, said rising bond yields have not yet diminished equities’ appeal. She attributed the increase in yields largely to strong capital spending demand and growth, rather than inflation alone, noting that some areas—particularly consumers—have not seen comparable growth. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
